items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Christopher; the mention of 'little Christopher' appears in the interviewer's prose/context, not the interviewee's speech.

ctx.x: Yes. But as I was saying, the announcer, he was a new announcer. I guess he was special for all the royal family from Buckingham Palace. They had just come over, I mean, you know, and this private audience.

Well, sorry to say, but that's when ABC and this -- this -- me, myself, at that time I was known as little Christopher, see? And on the 'Children's Hour' -- so anyhow, they figured out something for me to do. I just got a chance to do Morton Downey and a little bit of Paul Robeson, you
see. And that was it for me, you see.
